'''Maksym Radziwiłł''' (born 24 February 1988)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.math.mcgill.ca/radziwill/cv.pdf |title=Maksym Radziwill Curriculum vitae |website=math.mcgill.ca |access-date=16 April 2023}}</ref> is a Polish-Canadian mathematician specializing in [[number theory]]. He is currently a professor of mathematics at the [[New York University]].

== Life ==
He was born in [[Moscow]] in 1988. His family moved to Poland in 1991 where he graduated from high school and in 2006 to Canada.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.salon24.pl/u/fizyka-smolenska/931391,polak-potrafi-w-kanadzie |language=pl |title=Polak potrafi. W Kanadzie. |website=salon24.pl |date=3 February 2019 |access-date=16 April 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.rmf24.pl/nauka/news-maksym-radziwill-czyli-geniusz-matematyczny-na-spacerze,nId,3186886#crp_state=1 |language=pl |title=Maksym Radziwiłł, czyli geniusz matematyczny na spacerze... |website=rmf24.pl |author=Grzegorz Jasiński |date=5 September 2019 |access-date=16 April 2023}}</ref> Radziwill graduated from [[McGill University]] in Montreal in 2009, and in 2013 earned a PhD under  [[Kannan Soundararajan]] at [[Stanford University]] in California. In 2013–2014, he was at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] in [[Princeton, New Jersey]] as a visiting member, and in 2014 became a Hill assistant professor at [[Rutgers University]]. In 2016, he became an assistant professor at McGill.{{r|crm}}  In 2018, he became Professor of Mathematics at [[California Institute of Technology]], and in 2022 he moved to the [[University of Texas at Austin]].<ref name="University of Texas at Austin 2022">{{cite web | title=World renowned number theorist Maksym Radziwill joins UT | website=Department of Mathematics, University of Texas at Austin | date=2022-11-18 | url=https://www.ma.utexas.edu/about-us/news/entry/maksym-radziwill-joins-ut | access-date=2022-11-18}}</ref> In 2023, Radziwill joined [[Northwestern University]] as the Wayne and Elizabeth Jones Professor of Mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Maksym Radziwill: Department of Mathematics - Northwestern University |url=https://www.math.northwestern.edu/people/faculty/maksym-radziwill.html |access-date=2024-02-15 |website=www.math.northwestern.edu |language=en}}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==

In 2016, along with [[Kaisa Matomäki]] of the [[University of Turku]], Radziwill was awarded the [[SASTRA Ramanujan Prize]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Kaisa Matomaki and Maksym Radziwill SASTRA-Ramanujan Award for 2016|url=http://sas.sastra.edu/ramanujan/Ramanujan-Awards.php|website=SASTRA University|publisher=SASTRA University, Thanjavur, India|access-date=14 April 2017|archive-date=10 May 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170510043504/http://sas.sastra.edu/ramanujan/Ramanujan-Awards.php|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Shubashree Desikan|title=SASTRA Ramanujan prize for Radziwill, Matomaki|url=http://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/science/SASTRA-Ramanujan-prize-for-Radziwill-Matomaki/article16919741.ece|access-date=15 April 2017|work=The Hindu|date=21 December 2016}}</ref><ref name=crm>{{cite web|title=Matomaki and Radziwill to receive 2016 SASTRA Ramanujan Prize|url=http://www.crm.umontreal.ca/communiques/2016/Octobre/sastra2016prizepressrelease.pdf|publisher=Centre de Recherches Matthematiques, Universite de Montreal|access-date=14 April 2017|archive-date=26 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171026025842/http://www.crm.umontreal.ca/communiques/2016/Octobre/sastra2016prizepressrelease.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In February 2017, Maksym Radziwill was awarded the prestigious [[Sloan Fellowship]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sloan.org/fellowships/2017-Fellows|title=2017 Sloan Research Fellows|access-date=18 September 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170708075903/https://sloan.org/fellowships/2017-Fellows|archive-date=8 July 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://publications.mcgill.ca/reporter/2017/02/mcgill-mathematics-professor-awarded-sloan-fellowship/|title=McGill mathematics prof awarded Sloan Fellowship}}</ref>

In 2018, he was awarded the [[Coxeter–James Prize]] by the [[Canadian Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://cms.math.ca/Prizes/info/cj.html|title=Coxeter-James Prize |publisher=Canadian Mathematical Society|access-date= 6 September 2018}}</ref> In 2018 he was invited with Matomäki to present their work at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].

With Matomäki, he is one of five winners of the 2019 New Horizons Prize for Early-Career Achievement in Mathematics, associated with the [[Breakthrough Prize in Mathematics]].<ref>{{citation|url=https://blogs.ams.org/beyondreviews/2018/10/18/break-on-through/|title=Break on Through|work=Beyond Reviews: Inside MathSciNet|first=Edward|last=Dunne|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|date=20 October 2018}}</ref>
In the same year he was awarded the [[Stefan Banach Prize]] (2018) of the [[Polish Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ptm.org.pl/kategorie/konkursy/nagrody-glowne-ptm/nagroda-glowna-ptm-im-stefana-banacha|title=Laureates of Stefan Banach Prize|date=March 2019|website=[[Polish Mathematical Society]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190531061447/https://www.ptm.org.pl/kategorie/konkursy/nagrody-glowne-ptm/nagroda-glowna-ptm-im-stefana-banacha|archive-date=31 May 2019|url-status=dead|access-date=June 1, 2019}}</ref>  For 2023 he received the [[Cole Prize]] in Number Theory of the AMS.<ref>[http://www.ams.org/news?news_id=7112 Cole Prize in Number Theory  2023]</ref> In 2023, he was also invited to give a [[Stanisław Łojasiewicz#Łojasiewicz Lestures|Łojasiewicz Lecture]] by the [[Jagiellonian University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ptm.org.pl/zawartosc/maksym-radziwi%C5%82%C5%82-wyg%C5%82osi-wyk%C5%82ad-im-stanis%C5%82awa-%C5%82ojasiewicza-2023-15-maja-2023-godz-1600-kra|title=Maksym Radziwiłł wygłosi Wykład im. Stanisława Łojasiewicza 2023|website=ptm.org.pl|access-date=2024-11-17}}</ref>
